senses.gloss: ch. sameto join closely, be grouped.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 30:7">Targ. Job XXX, 7</cite> <he>בתתין</he> Ms. Var., read: <he>כָּתְתִין</he> (ed. <he>מתחברין</he>, h. text <he>יְסֻפָּחוּ</he>).—Denom. <cite ref="K01338"><he>כָּתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="K01337"><he>כִּתָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 44a:7">Ab. Zar. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>בדין הוא דכַתּוּתֵי לא וכ׳</he> by law it was necessary to grind it (the bronze serpent) to powder, v. <cite ref="K01393">preced.</cite>

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 24:23">Targ. Y. I Num. XXIV, 23</cite> (play on <cite ref="K00649"><he>כִּתִּים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 24:24">ib. 24</cite>) <he>מְכַתֵּת וכ׳</he> causes nations … to form alliances and incites them against one another.—Part. pass. <he>מְכַתַּת</he>, v. infra.

<cite ref="Sukkah 31b:12">Succ. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>כַּתּוּתֵי מִיכַּתַּת שיעוריה</he> the size which the Lulab must have, is (in the eyes of the law) crushed to powder (as an object of idolatry); <cite ref="Chullin 89b:1">Ḥull. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>כתותי מִכַּתַּת שיעורא</he> (or <he>מְכַתַּת</he>. v. supra).
<cite ref="Chullin 89b:1">Ib.</cite> <he>כל מה דמכ׳ וכ׳</he> the more it is crushed to powder, the better it is fitted (for covering the blood).

<cite ref="Yevamot 103b:12">Yeb. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>כִּדְמִכַּתֵּת דמי</he> (or <he>כִּדְמְכַתַּת</he>) the house doomed to destruction (<cite ref="Leviticus 14:45">Lev. XIV, 45</cite>) is to be considered as crushed to powder.

senses.gloss: to come in contact (hostile or friendly, cmp. זווג).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:11">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Q00100"><he>פגש</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 33:8">Gen. XXXIII, 8</cite>) <he>א״ל מִיכַּתֵּת אנא גביהון א״ל וכ׳</he> said he (Esau), I had a meeting with them. Said he (Jacob) they came to find grace &c. Said he, I have had enough blows; Yalk. ib. 133.
